subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw support first-class WebChat active-run adoption after a UI WebSocket reconnect, including consuming Gateway `inFlightRun`, or is the current event/history/session-state recovery contract sufficient?
rationale: Current main has several partial mitigations but no proven end-to-end WebChat reconnect recovery, and choosing the permanent contract affects Gateway protocol/session state and Control UI behavior.

options.title: Land active-run adoption
options.body: Implement Control UI recovery from current Gateway active-run data and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Revive the open recovery PR
options.body: Ask for the overlapping PR to be rebased, narrowed to current packages, and proven with real WebChat reconnect evidence.

options.title: Accept partial recovery
options.body: Close only if maintainers explicitly decide that current Stop visibility, event adoption, queued-send retry, and history refresh are the intended contract.

recommendation.title: Land active-run adoption
recommendation.body: Implement Control UI recovery from current Gateway active-run data and require live reconnect proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main Gateway/UI recovery surface is mostly attributed to this recent area contributor, making them the best routing candidate for the contract decision.
